has_more.description: Whether additional records exist beyond the current page

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor token for retrieving the next page of results

prev_cursor.description: Opaque cursor token for retrieving the previous page of results

offset.description: Offset from beginning of result set

total.description: Total number of records matching the query

active_participants.description: Displayed count after expiry and same-name cleanup, including the merchant when retained. It does not determine merchant_tier.

merchant_selection_count.description: Stored row count before this observation adds the merchant and cleans expired/duplicate records. Determines merchant_tier independently of active_participants.

description.example: 秘伝のスパイスを煮込んだカレー。スタミナが湧いてHPを回復する。

name.example: スパイス香る特製カレー

icon.description: Reserved asset ID; empty until production asset mappings are defined.

icon_url.description: Existing profile avatar URL or data URI; empty when unset.

action_wait_ms.description: Remaining legacy action wait in milliseconds (default 4 s after a successful command). While positive, every Gateway command except rescue, wake and place_say is rejected with 409 ACTION_WAIT.

bgimg_url.description: Self-authored SVG data URI for the initial town; production assets are deferred.

place_log.description: Viewer-filtered shared log of the current place, newest first (docs/architecture/place-log.md). Empty outside places with a log; a required read failure fails the observation.

members.description: Who is in the current place: facility NPCs or the observed home's residents first, then characters in arrival order whose last command was within the member window (docs/architecture/place-log.md#members). Empty outside places with a log; a required read failure fails the observation.

SceneSnapshot.description: Registered selected or feature-owned activity scene. Actual sleep, unfinished work, membership and runs override ordinary selection; conflicting exclusive facts are preserved. GET never joins, advances, settles or recovers gameplay.

private.description: A whisper the viewer sent or received.

PlaceLogEntry.description: One rendered place-log row. Name and colour are snapshots at write time; character IDs are never exposed.

icon_url.description: Avatar URL; empty when unset and for the NPC.

PlaceMember.description: One member of the current place. Appearance is a snapshot from the character's latest refresh; character IDs are never exposed.

id.description: Scheduled action ID, or sleep for the observed sleep/wake recovery timer.

is_ready.description: Deadline has elapsed. Pending/Processing work remains unfinished; this does not certify settlement.

properties.description: Action parameter names mapped to JSON Schema fragments, produced by contextActionSchema.

params_schema.description: Same strict ActionID-specific Gateway params schema, with explicit selected constants. Required lists the complete command; send full mutation params.

params_template.description: Explicit selected values only; never an implicit mutation-target binding.

PlayerContextResponse.description: Shared GET/post-command selected-scene composition with four slots and non-null arrays. Only connected, scene-appropriate eligible commands are offered; required reads fail the whole observation.

action.description: Catalog ActionID. Eligible entries do not certify adapter coverage.

params.description: Typed command parameters. Required values cannot be absent/null; unknown fields and actor overrides are rejected. May be omitted for no-input commands.

item_id.description: Explicit SecretShop catalog item ID; the service validates current availability.

quantity.description: Explicit quantity; the existing service accepts 1..99 and rejects other integers. No REST quantity default is applied.

text.description: Required non-null text. Line breaks are removed; at most 500 characters counted after legacy HTML escaping (legacy $max_comment). Control, zero-width, bidi-override and excessive combining characters are rejected. Stored verbatim as data.

recipient_name.description: Exact name of an existing character; an unknown name is rejected with 404 RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND.

text.description: Required non-null string. Whitespace-only text logs the bare ＠ささやき>name, as in legacy; other text follows place_say text rules.

color.description: #RRGGBB colour code; color_samples lists the palette.

aura_effect.description: Effect ID from the home_image effects.

avatar_id.description: imgur image ID (5-10 letters or digits), stored as https://i.imgur.com/<id>.gif; empty or omitted removes the avatar. Accepted only after the avatar unlock; before it a non-empty value is rejected and the stored avatar is kept.

bio_data.description: Every legacy profile field by key (home_profile fields); it replaces the stored profile, so omitted fields become empty. Values take up to 160 characters without ; < or >.

instance_id.description: One of the owned observation's items.

source.description: The item's source; defaults to inventory.

phrase.description: One line of up to 120 characters for the residents to say.

phrase_id.description: One of the owned observation's phrases.

notice_ids.description: Observed notice IDs to clear; unknown or already cleared IDs are ignored, so a notice that arrives later stays.

recipient_name.description: Exact recipient character name, as legacy addresses letters; may be the sender.

content.description: Letter body, validated as the Home letter body (line breaks removed, legacy-escaped length limit). The letter takes the sender's own color.

letter_id.description: An inbox letter ID; marks only the actor's copy read.
An inbox or outbox letter ID; removes only the actor's copy.

name.description: Skill name; validated by the custom skill service.

comment.description: Optional line spoken when the skill is used.

gems.description: Gem IDs for the three slots; an empty string leaves a slot unused. The chosen gems leave the gem box and the previous skill's gems return to it.

target_id.description: Public Home, available shop item, Casino room or town store ID, validated by the selected adapter. Room selection never grants admission.

params.description: Exactly one of offset or cursor. Cursor is accepted only for Home inbox/outbox/notices; empty cursor starts the existing keyset reader.

action.description: One of the activity scene `controls.actions`: an Indian or High & Low action, or a Doppel mark.

amount.description: Explicit gold amount; the Depot service rejects nonpositive amounts and amounts above the wallet.

item_id.description: Depot row to withdraw. Optional: while held gold fits in the wallet, the command collects it instead and leaves items untouched.

blessing.description: Prayer key or alias accepted by ParseBlessingType. NONE is rejected; canonical choices are GOLD, EXP, MONSTER, DROP and CASINO.

params.description: Optional non-null target ID or name; ID takes precedence. An omitted or missing target inspects the actor.

seal_id.description: Explicit seal ID; the service validates 1..12 and weapon applicability.

target.description: Equipped weapon or armor; existing service aliases are accepted.

name.description: Explicit custom name; an empty string resets it to the catalog name. Service validation and trimming apply.

slot.description: Explicit owned blacksmith storage slot; the service validates 1..3.

recipe_id.description: Explicit learned recipe from the observed compendium entries. Learning and Depot materials stay service-owned.

params.description: Legacy れしぴ: returns the compendium and, on the first view of a fully crafted compendium, awards comp_alc with its hall-of-fame induction (comp_alc_awarded).

item_instance_id.description: Explicit owned inventory or depot instance. Eligibility and ownership stay service-owned.

prize_id.description: Explicit prize ID from the observed prizes or u_prizes.

item_id.description: Owned depot instance or definition ID. A definition ID selects its first stored instance. One unit is listed; ownership stays service-owned.

price.description: Listing price in gold. The 1 to 999999 range stays service-owned.

listing_id.description: Explicit active listing from the observed listings. Funds and self-purchase stay service-owned.
Explicit listing from the observed owned_listings. Seller ownership stays service-owned.

town_id.description: Town scene ID (town1..town4) from the house_build template.

house_style.description: House style from the observed town.house_styles. Funds, town capacity and ownership stay service-owned.

town_id.description: Town scene ID (town1..town4) from the store_build template.

house_style.description: House style from the observed store_terms.house_styles. Funds, town capacity and ownership stay service-owned.

item_id.description: Owned Depot instance ID. One unit is listed.

price.description: Price in gold. The 1 to 999999 range and the listing limit stay service-owned.

item_id.description: Owned Depot instance ID. One unit is listed.

wish_item_name.description: Exact name of an existing weapon, armor or item wanted in exchange.

sale_id.description: Owned listing from the observed store sales; it returns to the Depot.
Gold listing from the observed store sales. Funds and self-purchase stay service-owned.
Barter listing from the observed store sales.

item_id.description: Owned Depot instance whose item name matches the listing's wish_item_name.

store_name.description: New signboard name; legacy character rules and uniqueness stay service-owned. Requires a 5,000 G balance without deduction.

wallpaper.description: Wallpaper key; its price is deducted.

furniture_id.description: Furniture ID. Requires a 1,000 G balance without deduction; at most five pieces.

interior_id.description: Interior from the observed store interiors.

name.description: New interior name; legacy character rules stay service-owned.

item_id.description: Owned gem-box instance ID or gem definition ID; the service selects one matching gem.

gem_id.description: Gem definition ID or name from the observed catalog. Job level, funds (catalog price x5) and gem-box capacity stay service-owned.

recipient_character_id.description: Explicit recipient character ID; self-transfer, existence and recipient gem-box capacity stay service-owned.

item_id.description: Owned gem-box instance ID or gem definition ID; the service selects one matching gem.

recipe_id.description: Explicit recipe ID from the observed recipes. Materials are matched by definition ID in the gem box, then depot; hand slots are excluded. The created gem enters the gem box without a capacity check.

item_id.description: Owned depot item instance ID, definition ID or name; hand-slot inventory items are not appraised. An unidentified orb loses one unit and its identified gem enters the gem box; other items are only named.
One of the altar scene's available_items IDs. Delivery to inventory or Depot stays service-owned.

stat.description: mhp, mmp, at, df or ag (legacy names accepted). 1 SP raises max HP/MP by 2 or another stat by 1.

sp.description: SP to offer, at least 1 and at most the actor's SP.

wish_id.description: One of the god scene's wishes. The realm comes from the recorded visit.

item_id.description: One of the medal scene's reward item IDs.

quest_id.description: A request from the helper scene. Omitted or empty only exchanges expired requests.

job_id.description: One of the job temple scene's jobs.
One of the job temple scene's recall_jobs, recalled as the current job.

old_job_id.description: A different recall_jobs entry, recalled as the previous job. The held recall_item is consumed and decides the memory kind.

memory_id.description: One of the job temple scene's future_memories IDs; the snapshot is consumed.

name.description: New guild name (16 characters, no whitespace or , ; " ' & < > \ / @ ＠). Costs 5,000G; the founder then enters the new guild's room.

guild_id.description: The guild association's selected guild; bound to the observed subject.

mark.description: One of the guild association scene's marks ("0"-"65"). Costs 3,000G; guild master only.

wallpaper.description: One of the guild association scene's wallpapers; costs its price. Guild master only.

message.description: Letter sent to every roster row, including pending applicants (200 characters).

color.description: #RRGGBB guild color; non-white colors are unique and NPC pink is reserved. Guild master only.

message.description: Guild message (200 characters, none of , ; " ' & < >). Guild master only.

member_id.description: A member row of the guild room scene.

title.description: Role title (6 full-width / 12 half-width characters). 追放 rejects a pending applicant or expels a member; any other title approves an applicant with it or retitles a member. Guild master only.

shop_type.description: Explicit shop from the observed scene; prices and the sales list belong to this shop.

item_definition_id.description: Explicit product ID from the shop's current job-level sales list. Funds and helper exclusions stay service-owned.

quantity.description: Explicit quantity; the service accepts 1..9999. One item goes to the empty hand, otherwise goods go to the Depot.

shop_type.description: Explicit shop from the observed scene.

item_instance_id.description: The item in the shop's hand (the observed sale_offer); other instances are rejected. One unit is sold at half the base price.

shop_type.description: Explicit shop; the accessory shop has no batch purchase.

items.description: Products from the shop's current sales list; everything is delivered to the Depot in one transaction.

recipe_target.description: Recipe target from the observed accessory-shop recipes. Both materials must be in the Depot; they are consumed on success and failure, and the product goes to the Depot.

item_id.description: One of the tavern scene's menu IDs.
One of the tavern scene's menu IDs.

seed_id.description: One of the plantation scene's seed IDs.

fertilizer_id.description: One of the plantation scene's fertilizer IDs.

item_no.description: One of the oracle scene's available_costumes item_no values.

wallpaper.description: One of the oracle scene's available_wallpapers names.

photo_id.description: One of the contest scene's photos.

title.description: Entry title, at most 40 characters, without whitespace or , ; " ' & < > @ ＠ (legacy photo.cgi).

entry_id.description: One of the contest scene's active_entries.

photo_id.description: One of the contest scene's photos.

CharacterActionSuccess.description: Known success is preserved, including result and HTTP 200, when refresh fails. Context is then null with CONTEXT_REFRESH_FAILED; re-fetch GET context only.

CharacterActionRejection.description: Known service or entry rejection retains its original 4xx/code even if refresh fails. No partial context is returned.

action.description: Game-specific masking uses ？？？ for a hidden action.

NavigationSubject.description: Both strings are empty when no subject is selected; otherwise validated by the registered adapter.

NavigationSelection.description: Bounded ordinary selection. Limit 0 means the default 20; no feature activity or actor identity is stored.

ScenePageInput.description: Exactly one of offset or cursor. Cursor is accepted only for Home inbox/outbox/notices; empty cursor starts the existing keyset reader.

BankSceneData.description: Owned Bank state from GetState; observation never runs NPC talk, navigates or mutates savings. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect.

mode.description: Present for service-verified activity continuations/recovery. entry_eligible is false for these controls; connected still determines execution support.

SceneSupport.description: Details are typed by the facility adapter. Connection and entry eligibility remain separate.

OwnedHomeDetails.description: Owner-only facts; public reads never fetch them.

phrases.description: Taught phrases, newest first; home_phrase_forget takes one of these IDs.

notices.description: Uncleared delivery notices, newest first. Observation never clears them; home_notice_ack does.

items.description: Held and Depot items home_item_use can inspect or use.

color_samples.description: The colour sample palette, offered only in the owner's home; empty otherwise.

power.description: Nominal strength; weapon and armor shops only.

weight.description: Nominal weight; weapon and armor shops only.

purchasable.description: Listed for shop_purchase (not requested by a helper quest).

batch_purchasable.description: Listed for shop_batch_purchase. The armor shop's batch listing hides armor whose number matches a requested weapon and keeps requested armor, like legacy.

ShopProduct.description: Exact GetCatalog facts. Purchase ID is explicit, independent of mutable navigation; quantity must be supplied separately. Presence means membership in the single or batch listing, not a funds/capacity guarantee.

sale_offer.description: The item in this shop's hand (weapon, armor, or the tool hand for the item and accessory shops) and its unit payout; null when that hand is empty.

recipes.description: Accessory shop only: the synthesis recipes.

sale_offer.description: The item in this shop's hand (weapon, armor, or the tool hand for the item and accessory shops) and its unit payout; null when that hand is empty.

recipes.description: Accessory shop only: the synthesis recipes.

actions.description: Eligible role/phase continuation candidates. Conflicts expose only verified recovery/leave candidates. Execution connection is reported separately in scene.support.actions.

party_id.description: Existing explicit run-to-party relation when present; a matching live roster and its single run are one activity. Missing linkage is never inferred.

revision.description: Current version of an enrolled run when present; observations never advance it.

CasinoLobbySceneData.description: Offset pages within the existing public window of at most 100 active rooms, sorted by ID. No snapshot or discovery beyond that window is promised. Reading does not admit the actor; service-owned idle expiry and its errors still apply.

CasinoSelectedSceneData.description: Public room summary; selecting is not joining or spectating. No admitted/private detail is exposed. Password and spectator allowance are enforced on explicit commands.

CasinoRoomControls.description: Service-owned role/phase candidates. Actions are room-game action values (Doppel marks included); actual commands revalidate all prerequisites. Spectators have no playable actions; conflict and sleep suppress play/start/kick.

SecretShopPurchaseParams.description: Explicit catalog target template; the purchase command additionally requires editable quantity.

SecretShopProduct.description: Exact SecretShop status item facts after required HelperQuest filtering. Selection and purchase use the catalog ID, never an inventory instance or implicit saved target.

SecretShopCatalogSceneData.description: Qualified read-only SecretShop observation. GET does not invoke NPC actions or purchase. Status and purchase REST operations are retired; NPC interaction REST operations remain registered.

SecretShopProductSceneData.description: Qualified read-only SecretShop observation. GET does not invoke NPC actions or purchase. Status and purchase REST operations are retired; NPC interaction REST operations remain registered.

DepotSceneItem.description: Owned storage instance facts; quantity is not the number of occupied depot slots.

item_count.description: Total occupied slots across the depot, before paging; not summed item quantities.

next_expansion_cost.description: Gold cost for the next expansion at observation time, or null at the purchased expansion cap. Execution charges the current service-owned tier.

pending_remittances.description: Held gold, oldest first. depot_withdraw collects it before items while the wallet has room; the excess over the wallet cap stays held.

DepotSceneData.description: Owned read-only Depot inventory/capacity. Offset pages preserve GetDepot order (currently instance ID ascending in persistence); no cross-page snapshot is promised. Missing depots remain empty in-memory projections. GET never creates, sorts or saves storage. REST operations remain registered pending verified mutation replacements.

post_adventure_messages.description: Post-adventure settlement messages keyed by participant character ID. Omitted when no messages exist; present only in the completion response, without persisted history.
Post-adventure settlement messages keyed by participant character ID. Omitted when no messages exist; present only in the completion response, without persisted history.

name.description: Effective display name: custom name, otherwise catalog name.
Effective display name: custom name, otherwise catalog name.

BlacksmithSceneData.description: Owned crystal balance, equipped customization, seal catalog/applicability and weapon storage. Observation never applies seals, names equipment or moves weapons.

available_seal_ids.description: Catalog seal IDs applicable to the equipped weapon; empty without one. Crystal sufficiency remains service-owned.

character_current_mp.description: Remaining MP carried between rounds, including zero. Absent only in pre-upgrade snapshots.

consumed_items.description: Cumulative combat consumption buffered until terminal settlement.

accumulated_exp.description: EXP earned by this member while alive at each cleared round.

accumulated_gold.description: Gold earned by this member while alive at each cleared round.

ChapelBlessingResponse.description: Gateway chapel_pray result in CharacterActionSuccess.result: the accepted blessing and HTTP-owned prayer confirmation. Both survive a failed context refresh; recover with GET only.

AlchemyCompendium.description: Counts cover the whole catalog; entries list only the combinations the character has learned. Product fields of an entry (name, result_item_definition_id, result_item_name) are present only once it has been crafted.

AlchemySynthesis.description: state becomes completed only through home sleep; elapsed time never completes it.

AlchemyRecipeView.description: Recipe as observed by the character. name, result_item_definition_id and result_quantity are present only after the character has crafted the recipe once.

guilds.description: Rank order; rank is the 1-based position.

members.description: Active members in roster order; the member count is its length.

round_limit.description: Map round limit. Layouts are not listed because they would disclose hidden passages.

round.description: Current shared round; it carries over floor changes.

round_limit.description: The current floor's round limit; a pitfall can leave round above it.

revision.description: Revision used by the service for atomic step validation.

material_1.description: Material definition ID (gem ID or item ID).

material_2.description: Material definition ID (gem ID or item ID).

victory_points.description: Cumulative GP earned from GvG rewards for ranking; spendable guild GP is stored separately in the guild points balance.

RescueRescueRecord.description: Gateway rescue_request result in CharacterActionSuccess.result: id, character_id, reason, penalty_seconds and created_at, including idle/no-op results. A failed context refresh preserves the result; recover with GET only.

StoreBuildResult.description: Result of the store_build Gateway command: store facts and an HTTP-owned confirmation message.

recovery_pending.description: Settlement is committed; publication still requires explicit recovery. GET never repairs it.

DungeonActiveEncounter.description: Pending enemy state and destination, retained across unresolved battles. Each hostile encounter currently has one enemy. A treasure encounter has null enemies and one chest per generated chest; it blocks movement until every chest is opened.

monster.description: Dungeon monster definition including encounter rewards.

items.description: Shared battle participant; field names follow corebattle.Participant.

chests.description: Native pending treasure chests; contents and inspection are not modeled yet.

statuses.description: Encounter-only participant statuses; an empty string represents a cleared ailment.

cmp.description: Remaining per-participant CMP, including explicit zero.

field.description: Remaining elemental field and anti-field duration between battle batches.

ChapelSceneData.description: Owned Chapel blessing and status; available_blessings[].type supplies the explicit chapel_pray blessing value. GET never prays or resets the prayer record. Required reads fail the whole observation.

round_limit.description: The current floor's limit; movement rejects once round reaches it, and a pitfall can leave round above it.

floor.description: Floor number of the current layout (1 on single-floor or entry layouts; branches and deeper floors increment from 1).

floor_name.description: Display title of the current floor (legacy $d_name, defaulting to the dungeon name).

DungeonExpeditionObservation.description: Owned single-run projection. Actor-only scouting; member roles have no leader controls. Terminal buffers have a null map and settlement retry eligibility. All four directions are listed while movement is allowed (walls reject on use), so hidden passages stay undisclosed. No private roster inventory, layout identity, event flags or provisional rewards.

BlackMarketSacrificeCandidate.description: Owned eligible instance and the points one sacrifice yields.

equipped.description: Inventory instance occupying an equipment slot; equipped rows are listed first.

BlackMarketSceneData.description: Owned points, visible prizes and paged sacrifice candidates. Observation never sacrifices, trades, chooses dialogue or creates a depot.

sacrifice_candidates.description: Current page: eligible inventory instances, then depot instances.

AlchemySceneData.description: Owned synthesis status and the current page of learned combinations. Observation never claims; delivery happens in scene_enter.

SceneEnterResult.description: Gateway scene_enter result in CharacterActionSuccess.result. Entering alchemy delivers a completed synthesis to the Depot regardless of its capacity; alchemy_claim carries the delivery. Entering home_adventure_record in the actor's own home saves eligible unlocks; adventure_record reports saved permissions and newly unlocked items. Visitor entry, GET and scene_back do not unlock.

FleaMarketSceneData.description: Active market listings in legacy order, plus the actor's own active listings. Observation never lists, purchases or cancels. Listing candidates come from the depot scene.

listings.description: Current page of all active listings, ordered by item kind, item number, price, then age.

owned_listings.description: All of the actor's active listings; the seller limit bounds this list.

GemStoreSceneData.description: Owned gem box plus the gem catalog for the actor's job level and every synthesis recipe; NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never buys, sends, synthesizes or appraises. Appraisal candidates come from the depot scene.

catalog.description: Gems purchasable at the actor's job level. price is the base price; a purchase charges five times it.

ExileBoard.description: Open petitions in submission order; empty unless eligible.

ExileSceneData.description: Exile board observation. GET never files, votes or withdraws.

ExileVoteResult.description: Gateway exile_approve/exile_oppose result. exile_petition returns ExilePetition.

custom_name.description: Weapon/armor custom name shown instead of the catalog name when set.

self.description: True when the actor was inspected: target omitted, missing, or the actor.

gems.description: Custom-skill gem IDs in slot order, empty slots omitted.

online.description: Sampled save within the presence window.

gem_names.description: Catalog names aligned one-for-one with gems, in the same slot order.

location.description: Null for offline targets. Actual activity overrides saved selection. Only coarse whereabouts are public; source failures fail inspection.

PlayerInspection.description: Common しらべる on a player. Wallet money is never included.

PlayerInspectionLocation.description: Public location only: quest category, home owner, or registered scene and title. Never includes activity identity, phase, roster, selected product or pagination.

TownInfo.description: Legacy town (town1..town4) with its house construction terms.

TownHouse.description: Active house in a town. character_id is the owner's Home scene subject.

TownDistrictSceneData.description: One legacy town: its active houses soonest expiry first, its active stores in construction order, and the ＠みせ terms. The town carries the ＠たてる terms.

StoreSceneData.description: Selected store with listings in legacy order. is_owner selects the owner or visitor commands.

source.description: Why the gold is held; clients render the receipt message. For fleamarket_payment, render <sender_name>からフリーマーケットの支払い; for store_payment, render <sender_name>から店の支払い; for contest_prize, render <sender_name>の賞金.

sender_name.description: Sender's character name, the arena name for pvp_prize, or the placement (第N回フォトコンテストM位) for contest_prize.

DepotRemittance.description: Gold held for the character until collected by depot_withdraw.

AltarSceneData.description: The actor's offered orbs and Ramia's awakening, plus whether a Ramia awakened by anyone is still present (30 minutes). Orbs are offered by Home item use; NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never prays or wishes.

orbs.description: Offered orb runes s/r/b/g/y/p; G after Ramia awakens.

available_items.description: altar_wish choices; empty until the actor's Ramia awakens.

WishingWellSceneData.description: Whether the actor may offer SP; SP and stats are in the character context. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never exchanges.

job_memory_active.description: A remembered (persistent) job memory blocks the exchange; a temporary one does not.

GodSceneData.description: Observed while the actor's god visit (from Home reins) is recorded, whatever the saved selection; leaving the scene through navigation forfeits the visit, and a granted wish ends it. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never grants.

wishes.description: god_wish choices for this realm; available is false when a requirement is not met.

TavernSceneData.description: The actor's menu, fullness and standing delivery order. tavern_delivery_cancel is offered only while delivery is set. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never orders or settles.

order_name.description: Name used by tavern_order: the profile like_food for the full course when set, otherwise the catalog name. tavern_delivery_reserve keeps the catalog name.

LotterySceneData.description: The actor's raffle coupons and the prize table of the raffle they would play; 300 or more coupons always play the special raffle. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never draws.

TakarakujiSceneData.description: The current takarakuji round. Reading it provisions the round when none is open; observation never draws or delivers.

draw_date_label.description: Draw date as the legacy unpadded JST year/month/day.

purchased.description: The actor holds this round's ticket.

PlantationSceneData.description: The actor's plot and its maturity, the seeds on sale and the usable fertilizers. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never harvests; maturity alone claims nothing.

fertilizers.description: Gold fertilizers and the item fertilizers the actor holds in the Depot or Inventory.

OracleSceneData.description: The actor's costume catalog (gated by job level, minus helper-requested items), the wallpapers and the worn costume. oracle_blackmarket is offered only to characters who qualify for the black market. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never buys.

ContestSceneData.description: The contest round state, the active entries open for voting and the actor's own photos. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never enters, votes or settles.

photos.description: The actor's photos, newest first; contest_photo_delete reports the photo's position in this list.

icon.description: Appearance identity reference; resolve via the asset catalog or its placeholder, not a legacy image URL.

HomeCollectionSceneData.description: The observed home owner's item collection (legacy アイテム図鑑): weapons, armors and items with their completion progress. Visitors see the owner's collection.

HomeMonsterBookSceneData.description: The observed home owner's monster book. Visitors see the owner's book.

HomeJobMasterSceneData.description: The observed home owner's job mastery. Visitors see the owner's mastery.

HomeProfileSceneData.description: The observed home owner's profile (legacy ぷろふぃーる): every profile field in form order, empty ones included. The owner may edit it with home_profile_update.

HomeAdventureRecordSceneData.description: The observed home owner's adventure record (legacy ぼうけんのきろく): clear counts of the cleared stages, stage26 per season, and their total.

HomeImageSceneData.description: The actor's own image (legacy いめーじ), offered in their own home after the adventure record's image unlock, with home_image_update.

effects.description: Selectable effects in the legacy form's order.

HomeCustomSkillSceneData.description: The actor's own custom skill, offered in their own home with custom_skill_set.

MedalSceneData.description: The medal castle: the actor's Small Medal balance and the prize tiers medal_claim exchanges (delivered to the Depot). NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never claims.

HelperSceneData.description: The shared helper request board, expired requests included; they remain resolvable until a helper_complete exchanges them. NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never renews or resolves.

JobTempleSceneData.description: The job temple: the choices job_change, job_recall and job_future_recall accept now, and the active job memory kind (absent when none; job_restore applies to persistent). NPC dialogue comes from npc_talk/npc_inspect. Observation never mutates.

recall_item.description: The held recall item, absent when none: item-168 starts a memory job_restore reverts, item-243 one that sleep reverts.

GuildMemberView.description: One roster row as ＠めんばー lists it (name＠title); pending applicants included.

decorations.description: Guild-owned display records, excluded from player membership and authority.

GuildAssociationSceneData.description: The guild association: a page of guilds, or the selected guild's roster (selected), the actor's active affiliation (null when none) and the mark and wallpaper choices. Commands are offered by the actor's current affiliation and role; guild_apply is bound to the selected guild. Observation never mutates.

GuildRoomSceneData.description: The actor's own guild room, entered only by active members: the roster with pending applicants and decorations. guild_color, guild_message and guild_assign are offered to the guild master, who also receives the colour samples. Observation never mutates; commands in the room keep the guild active.

color_samples.description: The ＠からー sample palette, offered only to the guild master; empty otherwise.

RecordUnlocks.description: Saved adventure-record permissions; clear counts alone do not unlock them.

newly_unlocked.description: New unlocks in notification order. Empty on repeated entry.

AdminApiKey.description: Master administrative API key for privileged operations.
AdminApiKey.name: X-Admin-Key

BearerAuth.description: Player session or Personal Access Token (p2_sk_...).
